# TopologicalPhaseTransition

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A qualitative change in collective dynamics (e.g., from quiescence to oscillation or synchrony) driven by the structure of higher-order interactions, not just coupling strength. Reveals new control knobs for tuning computational regimes in TCC/iNEST systems, enabling robust switching between processing and memory states.
